basic_details.short_information: The H.R.D. Department of Tata Memorial Hospital, Tata Memorial Centre (a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India) has invited online applications for one Biostatistician post under the CRS & DAE-CTC Project (A/c. No.0963), initially for six months, at Rs.45,000/- p.m. The essential qualification is M.Sc. in Statistics, the age limit is 35 years, and applications are accepted only online until 27 November 2026, 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

how_to_apply: Send your candidature through the online application only, at https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx.
Submit the application by 27/11/2026, 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).
Use a valid email ID. All correspondence is done through email only, and the date of interview is sent by email to eligible candidates only.
Internal candidates submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator.

Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Tata Memorial Centre does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of applications through the online route. Responsibility for receiving, downloading and printing related documents rests with the candidate.
important_instructions: If any candidate is found at any stage of recruitment not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. All outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. For enquiries, contact 24177000 Extn. 4664 or email [email protected].

Initially for a period of six months

content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre runs Tata Memorial Hospital, and the notice is issued by the hospital's H.R.D. Department (Project). The centre is described in the notice as a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The post is a project post under the CRS & DAE-CTC Project, and the job location is TMH, Parel.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit printed for the post is 35 years. The notice prints no age relaxation and no date for counting age. The notice asks candidates to appear for the position only if all the required course certificates are completed and available. Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification_and_experience: M.Sc. in Statistics. Experience in relevant field is desirable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Biostatistician
content_sections.text: Send your candidature through the online application only, at https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx . Submit the application by 27/11/2026, 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time). Use a valid email ID. All correspondence is done through email only, and the date of interview is sent by email to eligible candidates only. Internal candidates submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Tata Memorial Centre does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of applications through the online route. Responsibility for receiving, downloading and printing related documents rests with the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be initially screened, and eligible candidates will be called for interview. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience. Mere fulfilling of the prescribed qualifications will not entitle an applicant to be called. The centre also reserves the right not to call any candidate for interview without assigning any reason. Candidates called for interview must carry the online application form and original documents along with one set of copies, in support of the details given in the online application regarding qualifications and experience. Applicants without these will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The interview date is not printed in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If any candidate is found at any stage of recruitment not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. All outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. For enquiries, contact 24177000 Extn. 4664 or email [email protected] .
